d:
Prastut hai khas phaibar, potaishiyam aur entioksident se bharpur Traditional Jimikand Curry. dipavli par iski sabji banane ki parampara bhi hai. is vidiyo men dekhiye Jimikand ki Sabzi Banane ka Sahi Tarika, suran kaise katen, kaise ubalen taki khujli ki samasya na ho, grevi banane ka aasan tarika va sarving tips. is dipavli par Ol ki sabji / Oal ki sabji banayen va apne anubhav sheyar karen
Ingredients
Jimmikand-suran 300 grams
Tomato-tamatar-2 (200 grams)
Chilli-hari mirch-1
Ginger baton-ाdarak-1/2 inch
Curd-dahi-1/4 cup
Oil-ीaayal-4 tbsp
